gizmo.title: Puoro tuhi
gizmo.description: Ka whakaatu, ka pāho i te puoro tuhi, i ngā tab kitā, me te tohu kōrero puoro mā te alphaTex, te MusicXML rānei.

configure.title: Tohu AlphaTex
configure.description: Tohu alphaTex i roto mō te puoro tuhi. Whakatikaina tōtika hei tuhi tohu; ka penapenahia ki tētahi tauira kia mau tonu ai te mokowā.

configure.title: Kōnae puoro
configure.description: Tukuake, honoa rānei tētahi kōnae MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl), Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp) rānei. Ka whakakapi i te alphaTex i roto ina tautuhia.

advanced.title: Purei oro
advanced.description: Ka hohe hei taunoa - whakarongo ki te puoro tuhi e pāhotia ana e te hanganoro kua whakaurua. Whakawetohia mō te aratau tiro anake (kāore he oro).

advanced.title: Whakaaturia ngā kōwhiringa whakaatu
advanced.description: Whakaaturia ngā pātene topa, toro, me te tahora ki te pae kaipurei.

advanced.title: Whakaaturia ngā pātene kaweake
advanced.description: Whakaaturia ngā pātene tikiake MIDI me te tā/PDF ki te pae kaipurei.
